answer: Require a 5-of-7 jury quorum and slash every juror whose verdict diverges from the final median by more than one grade. Cost: an attacker needs 4 colluding jurors out of 7, each posting 300 POA, so 1,200 POA at risk per forged answer plus 100 epochs of vesting lost on detection.
